cohort: brats_oriented (250-patient stratified subset, all 16,074 tumor-positive slices)
gradcam_layer: model.layer4[-1] (7x7 upsampled to 240x240 via bilinear interpolation)

pointing_rule_15px.code: kernel_15 = cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE, (31, 31)); seg_masks_dilated15[i] = cv2.dilate(seg_masks_240[i].astype(np.uint8), kernel_15) > 0; peak_flat = int(np.argmax(cam240)); py, px = divmod(peak_flat, 240); pointing_15px[i] = 1.0 if seg_masks_dilated15[i, py, px] else 0.0
pointing_rule_15px.description: The ground-truth binary tumor mask (240x240) is morphologically dilated by an elliptical structuring element of diameter 31x31 pixels (radius = 15 pixels). A slice is a hit (1.0) if the peak Grad-CAM pixel (py, px) = argmax(cam240) falls within <=15 pixels of any ground-truth tumor voxel.

ebpg_tumor_energy.description: Fraction of total min-max normalized 240x240 Grad-CAM activation energy that falls strictly inside the ground-truth 2D binary tumor mask t_mask (seg_masks_240[i]).

topk_threshold_K.code: t_voxels = int(tumor_voxel_counts[i]); flat_cam = cam240.ravel(); flat_mask = t_mask.ravel(); topk_idx = np.argpartition(flat_cam, -t_voxels)[-t_voxels:]; inter_k = int(np.count_nonzero(flat_mask[topk_idx])); union_k = 2 * t_voxels - inter_k; dice_topk[i] = inter_k / float(t_voxels); iou_topk[i] = inter_k / float(max(1, union_k))
topk_threshold_K.description: Adaptive per-slice threshold K equal to the exact ground-truth tumor voxel count K = |M| = t_voxels in that 240x240 slice. The top K highest-intensity pixels in cam240 are selected as the binary prediction P_K (so |P_K| = |M| = K), where Dice@TopK = 2|P_K cap M| / (|P_K| + |M|) = |P_K cap M| / K.
